plan.title: RFQ Required Terms Block Vendor Submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the single pricing line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit a 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured event.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited vendor portal in the separate vendor session.
Open the event's Technical stage as the vendor.
Verify the RFQ-only required clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing submission screen.
Accept only the optional clause.
Attempt submission with the required clause still unchecked; the vendor must be blocked and the refusal must identify the required clause.
Verify the required RFQ clause remains visible for acceptance after the blocked submission.
Accept the required clause.
Submit the quote after all required terms are accepted.
Verify the vendor bid was successfully submitted.
